svg.title: From microscopic ions to a verified surface response
svg.desc: Research banner for atomcrystal. A stable 64-ion polar-dimer model yields a bulk dielectric law and a surface-mode prediction. Direct vacuum incidence cannot supply the required parallel momentum. An ideal periodic source with period two pi over square root six supplies that momentum. An independent finite ionic-Maxwell driven calculation certifies at least fourfold interface magnetic-intensity contrast, at least sixty percent near-interface magnetic localization, and the preserved eigenfrequency discrepancy bound of 0.004. The central normalized magnetic-intensity depth profile is drawn from the exact rational drive certificate at squared frequency three. Ion positions are schematic. The comparison uses equal generalized source forcing, not equal incident power; no passive-grating efficiency or reflectivity is claimed.
svg.text: From microscopic ions to a verified surface response
A theory-selected coupling experiment, tested against explicit ions and Maxwell fields.
Ions schematic; depth profile from the exact s = 3 certificate. Shading: |z| ≤ 1.
I = Hvac(15)² + Hmat(15)² · equal generalized forcing
